news.headline: Citing short week, Colts sticking with Daniel Jones at QB despite dreadful start
news.description: Colts coach Shane Steichen said the team will stick with Daniel Jones as starter despite a two-interception start that earned him a 2026-worst 1.7 QBR.

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: Mahomes has biggest game in years; Taylor struggles
news.description: Jahmyr Gibbs, Patrick Mahomes and Emmett Johnson put fantasy teams on their back in Week 10, while Jonathan Taylor and the Packers and Panthers' passing games had quiet days.

news.headline: Kirk Cousins emotional after win in Vikings return, reflects on 'tough 3 years'
news.description: Kirk Cousins was emotional discussing his return to the Vikings after their victory over the Packers.

news.headline: Browns' Deshaun Watson relishes 'special' win vs. Texans after engineering rally
news.description: Deshaun Watson, who delivered his sixth game-winning drive of the season, called the 27-24 victory over the Texans, his former team, "definitely special."

news.headline: QB Jordan Love, Packers frustrated after blowout loss at home to Vikings
news.description: Jordan Love and the Packers expressed their frustration after a 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

news.headline: Bijan Robinson: Falcons deserved boos in loss to Chiefs
news.description: Fans at Mercedes-Benz Stadium booed the Falcons after another poor offensive showing Sunday.

news.headline: Raiders lose TE Brock Bowers to ankle injury vs. Seahawks
news.description: Brock Bowers was ruled out of Sunday's matchup against the Seahawks after suffering a right ankle injury in the opening quarter.

transactions.text: Placed LB Jack Campbell on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the active roster. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas and RB Jabari Small from the practice squad.
Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.

insights: 2026 cap number of $283K is the 63rd-largest on the roster.
